game_title: Shelf Sorter – Fallen Statue Garden Defense
game_concept: A action defense set in Eldritch Ruins – Fallen Statue Garden, a garden of fallen statues: the spirit seeker must handle stone sentinels while practicing lists. Core idea – Shelf Sorter: Use sort() to rearrange shelves of moon crystals from smallest to largest.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Fallen Statue Garden: a garden of fallen statues
core_gameplay_loop: In Fallen Statue Garden, repeat each round: Use sort() to rearrange shelves of moon crystals from smallest to largest. Each round, stone sentinels strike the ancient lock, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the order_score value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the ancient lock from stone sentinels in Fallen Statue Garden: keep the order_score meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 63-second timer ends.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: order_score drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 63-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 7 – Lists | Level 6 (applied tier): Shelf Sorter
assets_style: mysterious pixel-art ruins: mossy stone pillars, overgrown arches, faint eldritch glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Shelf Sorter' (Week 7 slot 6), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Fallen Statue Garden'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Eldritch Ruins
region.mood: eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how order_score changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against stone sentinels in Fallen Statue Garden.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 63 seconds while order_score > 0.
